note.ja: 独立NumPy/SciPy参照、行列再構成・直交性・特異値・階数・最小二乗残差を確認します。PDEの参照解カードとは別の線形代数検証です。 別版では条件数、右辺摂動、数値階数の閾値を変え、残差と係数の前進誤差を分けます。LAPACKと実際の二進入力から作る高精度参照の役割を区別し、QR／SVD全般や任意の悪条件行列の保証にはしません。
note.en: Check independent NumPy/SciPy references, reconstruction, orthogonality, singular values, rank and least-squares residuals. This is linear-algebra validation rather than a PDE reference-solution card. A separate release varies conditioning, right-hand-side perturbations and numerical-rank thresholds while separating residual from coefficient forward error. Distinguish LAPACK from high-precision references built from actual binary input; no general QR/SVD or arbitrary ill-conditioned-matrix guarantee is implied.
